summary: The legal string length is at most 100, which is too small for the runtime harness to separate linear stack processing from correct repeated replacement; the implementation nevertheless performs one bounded pass with at most one push and one pop per character.

replacement_checks.evidence: Each of the n characters is read once, pushed at most once, and popped at most once, establishing linear work over the complete legal domain.
Cases cover both removable pairs, no removal, reversed pairs, independent pairs, cross-kind cascades, long center-out cascades, empty results, and unmatched boundaries.
